page.overview:
What is Tetsunodokuga?

Iron Moth is a robotic or cybernetic insectoid moth Paradox Pokémon. It is very similar if not outright identical to Volcarona in appearance, though appearing as a robotic/cybernetic version of it. It has a mostly black body with a white thorax mimicking fur. It has four small inward-pointing limbs on its thorax, though they now appear to lack a function and do not seem to move very much. Its metallic black thorax creases into a mostly black plump abdomen bordered by light teal, though it is thinner and more aerodynamic-shaped than its present day counterpart. There are two oval-shaped black limb-like appendages, one on each side of its abdomen. It possesses six glowing, fiery orange, diamond-shaped wings tipped at the center with red metal, and black triangular markings within. Its robotic wings float independent of it's body. It's eyes have a cross pattern going through them to split them into four compound eyes that are a dark shade of orange, and two crimson antennae bordering its head and pointing up like horns.

According to the paranormal magazine "Occulture", it sporadically descends from the skies to attack random people for no clear reason. The magazine claims that Iron Moth may have been sent by aliens to spy on humanity. Though it is dangerous as a mysterious robotic Pokémon from an unknown future, when tamed by a skilled trainer, it is able to bond and express some level of emotion (as seen in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet).

Iron Moth, unlike its present-day counterpart Volcarona, levitates skillfully without the use of its blazing, glowing metallic wings, which move rigidly. It can emit and control flames and venom.

Iron Moth is the Future equivalent of Slither Wing.
